description: This file contains integration tests for authentication endpoints (/auth/register, /auth/login, /auth/me) in a FastAPI application, using an in-memory SQLite database for testing purposes.

methods.name: using_inmemory_db()
methods.description: Context manager to set up and tear down an in-memory SQLite database for testing, including overriding the DATABASE_URL environment variable and initializing database tables.

methods.name: _client()
methods.description: Creates and returns a FastAPI TestClient instance for testing the app.

methods.name: test_register_and_login_success_flow()
methods.description: Test that a user can register and then login successfully, and verify the returned access token and user info.

methods.name: test_register_duplicate_email_returns_409()
methods.description: Test that attempting to register with an email that already exists returns a 409 Conflict status.
